label: Conditional calculations on a dated basis, not forecasts. Every assumption carries its reason; observed inputs cite ledger ids. v1: the v0 'base_health_adjusted' scenario is withdrawn (it implied an unstated receivables forecast); replaced by a plain sensitivity that prints its implied working-capital build. v2: wording fixes only; no number changed.

price.why: NVDA regular-session close used for the freeze
price.source: griddb raw_series YF:NVDA:close (pull 2026-11-12 23:33Z); unqualified price input per #1085

excluded_from_net_cash: nvda-10q-q2fy27-equity-investments-99b: equity stakes are not counted as cash (sensitivity only)
nvda-10q-q2fy27-guarantee-total: guarantees are contingent, not debt (sensitivity only)

qoq_growth.why: Q3 at the low end of the $108.0B ±2% guide (nvda-pr-q3fy27-outlook-no-china)
digestion: no growth while the CEO search runs and customers re-plan
commitment slippage: announced intentions/capacity plans convert later than planned
a down quarter of the size seen in prior semiconductor digestion cycles (illustrative, not measured)

fcf_margin.why: Q2 FY27 level persists: FCF $21.3B / revenue $96.2B (nvda-pr-q2fy27-fcf, nvda-pr-q2fy27-revenue), working-capital drag from 60-day DSO and supply commitments

fcf_multiple.why: de-rated multiple on forward FCF; assumption, not measured

qoq_growth.why: growth slows from the guide pace; assumption

qoq_growth.why: Q3 beats the guide by 5%, similar to Q2 (96.2 vs 91.0 guide, +5.7%) and Q1 (81.6 vs 78.0, +4.6%) (nvda-pr-q2fy27-outlook-given-in-q1, nvda-pr-q1fy27-outlook-given-in-q4)
PORTS-Pike / AI-cloud commitments start converting; assumption

fcf_margin.why: working capital normalises toward Q4 FY26 (51%) and Q1 FY27 (59%) levels
